caption: The drawing features a single man's legging made of buckskin with beadwork, depicted vertically on a plain beige background. The legging is predominantly a light yellowish-tan color, indicating the buckskin material. On the left side of the legging, there is a vertical decorative strip with a beadwork pattern consisting of alternating triangular shapes outlined in red and filled with blue-green color, set against a white background with small black grid-like details. Alongside the beadwork strip, a fringe of long, narrow strips in shades of brown, red, and white extends down almost the entire length of the legging. Some folds and shading in blue and darker tan tones indicate dimension and the drape of the material. At the bottom left of the image, there is handwritten text giving identifying details about the item, including notes on its dimensions, case location, date, and artist.
title: Buckskin Legging with Beadwork
